basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Forward Deployed Engineer | Solution Architect for Data & AI | Customer-Facing Technical Lead
basics.summary: Forward deployed engineer who runs technical discovery, builds POCs, and turns them into production wins that move revenue. At LumApps I own the AI stack that 2x outbound conversions and forecasts $1M in quarterly revenue, presenting outcomes directly to C-level. Anand Creations is my forward deployed practice: embedding with teams, translating business problems into working prototypes, winning technical champions. Deep across data (PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Elastic Search, Neo4j), cloud (GCP, AWS), and modern AI (LLMs, RAG, agentic systems), with a decade of speaking at conferences and demoing to executives.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Led technical discovery through production for a global SaaS platform: agent architecture, POCs, executive demos, and cost-per-request instrumentation. Report directly to C-level on outcomes. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, forecast $1M in quarterly revenue.

Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ data silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, transcripts, product usage) into one queryable memory every agent reads and writes. Turned scattered enterprise data into a single, high-trust source for downstream AI.
Own eval pipelines, agent tracing (LangSmith), and cost telemetry so every demo and POC comes with the numbers the buyer needs to greenlight.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Co-owned GTM launches with Sales and PM (Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis). Each shipped with instrumentation so we knew within a week if it moved the needle. Employee Referral System became the top revenue channel ($1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR).
Built GenAI demo system for Sales: auto-generates personalized content from Salesforce data so every pitch feels custom-built for that customer. Improved demo speed and close rates on real deals.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated; the buying team saw the ROI in the first invoice cycle.

Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams: redesigned indexing and ranking (Elastic Search, ClickHouse) with measurable engagement lift. Ran on-call and observability (Grafana, Datadog, Logz.io) for global production systems.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on technical architecture, scalability, and data/AI readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions. Presented recommendations to investment committees.
Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems; advised multiple portfolio companies on data platform choices, AI adoption, and building teams that ship.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Shipped end-to-end drone delivery platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS). Enterprise-grade reliability enabled partnership with Unilever and a CES Las Vegas showcase.
Ran technical customer conversations from architecture demo through onboarding. 500+ real-world deliveries, 40% faster than incumbents, 99.5% safety record.
